layers.published: GPAT v1 items 1–21: labels, descriptors at 1 and 5, Mandatory hot/cold (GPAT manuscript, Table 1)
layers.derived: ESGE Certification Taskforce additions (Oct 2026): entrustment scale, item 22, Model column, model notes, sentinels, pass rule

items.label: Tip control
items.descriptor1: Uncontrolled, shaky and undirected
items.descriptor5: Controlled, stable and purposeful

items.label: Fully appreciates/demonstrates extent of the polyp to be resected
items.descriptor1: Focusses on one area, does not demonstrate appreciation of the entire polyp
items.descriptor5: Clearly appreciates entire extent of polyp; approach and resection reflect this
items.modelNote: The extent is the marked perimeter.

items.label: Positioning with respect to the polyp
items.descriptor1: Not at 6 o’clock, far from the colonoscope, fluid covering lesion (poor use of gravity)
items.descriptor5: Lesion at or near 6 o’clock, close, fluid away from the lesion (good use of gravity)
items.modelNote: Scope rotation, distance and fluid are scored; patient repositioning cannot be reproduced.

items.label: Technique selected is appropriate for the polyp
items.descriptor1: No clear need for en-bloc if selected, lesion unsuitable for cold snare, no hot snare <10mm
items.descriptor5: Correct decision for en-bloc vs piecemeal/hot vs. cold

items.label: Injection is performed in the correct plane
items.descriptor1: Injection infrequently results in sustained submucosal lifting (transmural/intramucosal)
items.descriptor5: The submucosal plane is quickly found and rapidly results in sustained mucosal lifting

items.label: Injection is performed dynamically
items.descriptor1: Once in the submucosa, no movement of the needle away from the muscularis
items.descriptor5: Once in the submucosa, graduated movement of the needle away from the muscularis

items.label: Injection is used to improve lesion access
items.descriptor1: Injection does not facilitate access to the target lesion
items.descriptor5: Injection clearly facilitates access to the target lesion

items.label: Appropriate snare size/type selected
items.descriptor1: Too large/small and of incorrect type
items.descriptor5: Snare of appropriate size and type

items.label: Stable position with lesion at 6 o’clock OR transformed to 6 o’clock
items.descriptor1: Snare position is not consistently maintained at 6 o’clock and/or the position is unstable
items.descriptor5: Snare position is consistently maintained at 6 o’clock and the position is stable

items.label: Maximizing snare capture
items.descriptor1: Poor, scrapes surface/no downward pressure/no aspiration, incomplete mucosal excision
items.descriptor5: Good capture/downward pressure/aspiration resulting in complete capture of target tissue

items.label: Snare V precisely visualized during placement and closure
items.descriptor1: Snare V not visualized during closure and far from the colonoscope
items.descriptor5: Snare V visualized consistently during closure and near to the colonoscope

items.label: Residual tissue islands avoided if piecemeal resection or complete if en bloc
items.descriptor1: No normal margin or no use of transected tissue edge, tissue islands/incomplete en-bloc
items.descriptor5: > 2–3 mm normal margin, uses transected tissue edge, no tissue islands/complete en-bloc
items.modelNote: Margin judged against the marks; target B is expected en bloc.

items.label: Moves closed snare to confirm independent movement from deeper structures
items.descriptor1: Does not check tissue mobility prior to transection with respect to deeper structures
items.descriptor5: Checks mobility prior to transection with respect to deeper structures

items.label: Lifts snare away from muscularis propria prior to cutting
items.descriptor1: Does not lift the snare prior to applying electrosurgical energy
items.descriptor5: Lifts the snare away from the muscularis prior to the application of electrosurgical energy

items.label: Mucosa: detects and removes residual adenomatous tissue within the defect
items.descriptor1: Does not check for residual adenomatous tissue and/or does not remove successfully
items.descriptor5: Checks for residual adenomatous tissue and removes it successfully

items.label: Thermal ablation of the post-EMR margin
items.descriptor1: Unsteady, results in areas of incomplete ablation, ablates visible polyp tissue, messy result
items.descriptor5: Steady, systematic, does not ablate visible polyp tissue, complete ablation of the margin
items.modelNote: Scored on target A; non-perfused tissue whitens differently, so judge the technique.

items.label: Submucosa: detects and treats any bleeding vessels within the defect
items.descriptor1: Neither detects nor treats bleeding vessels; treats benign submucosal appearances
items.descriptor5: Detects/treats bleeding vessels; does not treat benign submucosal appearances

items.label: Muscularis: detects and treats Deep Mural Injury ≥ 2 (Sydney classification)
items.descriptor1: Misses signs of deep mural injury (types II–V) which require clip closure
items.descriptor5: Detects and treats types II–V deep mural injury or confirms they are not present

items.label: Placement of through-the-scope clips
items.descriptor1: Poor tissue capture, poor use of suction and positioning, incorrect orientation
items.descriptor5: Good use of suction, positioning, and rotation, capture required tissue, secure closure
items.modelNote: When deep mural injury or perforation is present.

items.label: Use of polyp retrieval device
items.descriptor1: Poor positioning, does not capture all pieces, no sequential place and retrieve technique
items.descriptor5: 6 o’clock position, sequential place and retrieve technique, captures all pieces successfully
items.modelNote: Only if the station includes retrieval.

items.label: Use of coagulation grasper
items.descriptor1: No water, does not wait for bleeding cessation prior to coagulation, does not tent vessel
items.descriptor5: Uses water to identify vessel, confirms correct placement after closure, tents vessel

items.label: Overall entrustability for this case
items.descriptor1: Not ready to perform an EMR of this difficulty without the assessor
items.descriptor5: Ready to perform an EMR of this difficulty independently (on the model: controls injection and snare resection of the standard targets safely and without help)

passRule.patientThresholdStatus: proposal — same rule as the model station, to be confirmed by the Certification Taskforce

researchScore: Published GPAT % (sum of applicable fields / maximum, SMSA-weighted). Research and formative only; never used for certification.
